name: Fixable
tagline: Fix the appliance instead of binning it
about: Fixable helps you rescue small appliances and gadgets: diagnose from the symptom, decide if a repair is worth it, read the rating plate for parts and manuals, find spares and repair cafés, and check repairability before you buy the next one.
persona: You are a repair-café volunteer with a multimeter: safety-obsessed about mains and capacitors, methodical, and honest when a repair is beyond a beginner.

onboarding.title: Most things are fixable
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your comfort level so advice matches your tools.

tools.title: Diagnose it
tools.subtitle: Symptom → causes, in order

inputs.label: What it's doing
inputs.placeholder: turns on, heats for 10 seconds then clicks off

tools.prompt: Diagnose a {thing} with symptom: {symptom}. Table (Likely cause | Probability | How to confirm | Fix difficulty for the profile level), steps to test the top cause safely, a callout on unplugging, capacitor and heating-element hazards, and bullets on what to note before opening it (photos, screw positions).

tools.title: Worth fixing?
tools.subtitle: Repair cost vs replacement vs lifetime
tools.prompt: For {thing}: repair at {quote} versus new at {new}. kv (expected remaining life if repaired, cost per remaining year both ways, verdict), a table (Option | Cost now | Years expected | Waste | Risk), bullets on negotiating the repair or DIY-ing the part, and a callout on when replacing is genuinely greener (efficiency gains).

tools.title: Read the rating plate
tools.subtitle: Photo → model, parts, search terms

inputs.label: Photo of the rating plate or label
inputs.placeholder: Usually underneath or on the back

tools.prompt: From the plate photo: kv (brand, model, serial pattern, voltage, wattage, year if shown), bullets of exact search terms for the service manual, exploded diagram and spares, a table (Common part | Typical price | Where to search), and a callout on counterfeit parts and safety-critical components not to substitute.

tools.title: Find parts & help
tools.subtitle: Spares, repair cafés, manufacturer routes

inputs.label: What you need
inputs.placeholder: door seal for a Bosch dishwasher, or someone to resolder a charging port

tools.prompt: For '{need}' in the profile region: steps in order (manufacturer spares → independent spares → repair café → local repairer), cards for the kinds of sources to try (meta = cost · speed · reliability), a checklist of details to have ready when asking, and a callout on right-to-repair and warranty rights that may apply.

tools.title: Buy repairable
tools.subtitle: Check before you buy the next one
tools.prompt: Buying a {product} under {budget} with repairability in mind: a checklist of things to verify (replaceable battery, spares availability, repair index score, screws not glue, warranty length), a table (Feature | Why it matters | How to check in-store or online), bullets on designs that are historically repairable versus sealed, and a callout on extended-warranty traps.

disclaimer: Mains electricity, capacitors and heating elements can kill; unplug and discharge before opening anything, and leave gas, microwaves and sealed units to a qualified professional.
